2116257486038810821.en_summary: Cataclysmic session on Wall Street. AI demand holds but financing cracks: Anthropic reportedly not investment grade post-IPO with over $800B compute commitments to 2045. Hyperscalers and $AVGO continue to carry the load while $NVDA discusses guarantee on Nscale. Semis pricing peak capex though neither capex nor ARR slowing much. SOX -10%, $INTC crushed -30% worst day since 1974, $NVDA -5%, Mag7 limited damage. Much demand pulled forward. Part of the drop is mechanical like 2020 (CTAs, vol targeting, SOXL rebalancing). Looks like violent rotation out of tech rather than general equity flight. Next catalyst is Anthropic October ARR, IPO and OpenAI raise. AI infrastructure thesis unchanged but volatility is the price. By @Frenchie_.
2116257486038810821.zh_summary: 華爾街災難性交易日。AI 需求仍在但融資出現裂縫：Anthropic 據報 IPO 後非投資級，至 2045 年計算承諾超過 8000 億美元。超大規模業者與 $AVGO 繼續承擔，而 $NVDA 正討論對 Nscale 的擔保。半導體定價為資本支出見頂，但資本支出與 ARR 均未明顯放緩。SOX 跌 10%，$INTC 暴跌 30% 為 1974 年以來最差單日，$NVDA 跌 5%，Mag7 損傷有限。大量需求提前實現。部分跌幅為機械性如 2020 年（CTA、波動率目標、SOXL 再平衡）。看起來是科技股劇烈輪動而非全面股票撤離。下一個催化劑是 Anthropic 10 月 ARR、IPO 與 OpenAI 融資。AI 基礎設施論點未變，但波動是代價。（@Frenchie_）
